gold_leg_caveat: GC=F (COMEX gold futures) is used as the gold leg because XAUUSD spot daily bars are not obtainable in a PIT-safe way (Yahoo XAUUSD=X/XAU=X -> 404; stooq throttled). The venue-correct FXTM sample is only ~26 daily bars (< 30). Transferability of any result to the FXTM spot execution venue is NOT established.
note: H21/H22/H23 are NOT modified and stay NOT_TESTABLE. All Round 3 hypotheses are new ids.

hypotheses.hypothesis: a decisive DXY daily move is followed by an opposite-direction gold move on the next day
hypotheses.mechanism: dollar-priced asset arithmetic: a large same-day dollar impulse pushes the USD price of gold the other way; if part of that impulse is flow rather than information, the next session partially continues
hypotheses.invalid_condition: DXY reverses its state on the next bar
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: daily cross-market state (no intraday analogue in H01-H23)

hypotheses.hypothesis: a decisive daily change in the 10Y Treasury yield is followed by an opposite gold move
hypotheses.mechanism: discount-rate channel: yields are the opportunity cost of a non-yielding asset; a decisive daily yield move re-rates gold with a one-session lag
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: official-yield cross-market state; no intraday analogue

hypotheses.hypothesis: a decisive VIX jump is followed by a same-direction gold move (safe-haven bid)
hypotheses.mechanism: risk aversion: a decisive volatility repricing coincides with a flight to hedges; the gold bid persists into the next session if the risk shock is not immediately reversed
hypotheses.invalid_condition: VIX retraces below its prior level
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: risk-state cross-market relation (the relation is pre-declared and falsifiable, not assumed)

hypotheses.hypothesis: a GC/XAUUSD divergence is resolved in favour of XAUUSD on the next day
hypotheses.mechanism: same-underlying arbitrage pressure should close a temporary basis divergence
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: basis divergence between gold futures and spot
hypotheses.blocked_reason: DATA-BLOCKED: XAUUSD spot daily is unavailable (Yahoo 404 / stooq throttled); the venue-correct FXTM daily sample is ~26 bars (< 30). Target S1 cannot be built without violating the no-proxy-substitution rule for this specific hypothesis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: when DXY and the 10Y yield move decisively in the SAME direction, gold moves opposite the next day
hypotheses.mechanism: two independent price channels agreeing (currency + discount rate) makes the re-rating more likely to persist for one session
hypotheses.invalid_condition: the two signals disagree on the next bar
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: two-channel agreement; exactly ONE combination frozen (no enumeration)

hypotheses.hypothesis: when DXY rises decisively AND VIX jumps decisively, gold rises the next day
hypotheses.mechanism: simultaneous dollar strength and risk repricing is a stress signature in which the hedge bid usually dominates the dollar channel for one session
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: stress co-occurrence; exactly ONE combo frozen

hypotheses.hypothesis: a three-variable macro agreement (DXY down, 10Y down, VIX up) is followed by a gold rise (and the mirror by a fall)
hypotheses.mechanism: a coherent macro state (easier dollar + easier rates + rising risk premia) is the canonical gold-supportive backdrop; the mirror state is the canonical gold-negative backdrop
hypotheses.invalid_condition: the macro state breaks up on the next bar
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: exactly TWO pre-declared states (no combinatorial enumeration); note: distinct from H21 (intraday, and H21 stays NOT_TESTABLE/unchanged)

hypotheses.hypothesis: a DXY state FLIP between t-1 and t (down->up or up->down) is followed by an opposite-direction gold move on t+1
hypotheses.mechanism: regime flips in the dollar are the moments when positioning is least settled; the gold reaction to a fresh dollar regime is more informative than the level itself

signal_definition.state_definition: DXY daily return sign with a 0.30% dead-band

hypotheses.invalid_condition: the new DXY state reverses again on t+1
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: uses only state(t-1) and state(t) to trade at t+1 (never state(t+1))
